scope:
Cover the C_de=1 branch of P3+P4 in the four tight-cut attachments.

Enumerate only the four P4 columns; propagate the sole other degree-two
Z vertex, its two leaves and the four isolated columns. Quotient the
resulting supports by explicit graph isomorphisms. Boundary certificates
are then needed only for the representatives, without a rank assumption.

boundary_result.scope:
Explore the exact boundary moments of one tight-cut norm16 support.

Local base-column masks cover every possible simple vertex; the LP assigns
multiplicities and all missing common neighbours of the 35-vertex base.
Feasible does not construct edges among simples. Infeasibility is reported
as exact only when an integral Farkas certificate passes exact checks.
boundary_result.message: The problem is infeasible. (HiGHS Status 8: model_status is Infeasible; primal_status is None)
